gloss: having one's hands full; fully occupied

definitions.gloss: having one's hands full; fully occupied; unable to take on more
definitions.explanation: So busy with what one is already doing that there is no time or capacity for anything else.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{手|て}いっぱいだ。
examples.english: My hands are full right now.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{手|て}いっぱいで、⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧どころで⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I'm so busy with work that a trip is out of the question.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{手|て}いっぱいな⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{他|ほか}→他：04129_hoka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}い→手伝い：02488_tetsudai⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I have my hands full with my own things, so I can't help anyone else.

notes:
Also written {手一杯|ていっぱい}. Usually 〜⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{手|て}いっぱいだ, naming what keeps one busy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{手|て}いっぱいだ: to be swamped with work
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{手|て}いっぱい: busy enough with one's own affairs
- ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人数|にんずう}→人数：03132_ninzuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{手|て}いっぱいだ: the present staff can't handle more

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{精一杯|せいいっぱい}→精一杯：13774_seiippai⟧: with all one's might; about effort, not about being too busy
